title: Births to School: Class 1 Entry Monitor
note: Expected Class 1 entrants are derived from registered live births about six years earlier (birth year = academic-year start - 6), adjusted for infant survival and net entry. Actual intake is EMIS Class 1 enrolment where available; later years are a projection of an already-born cohort. District, block and school figures scale the state pipeline by that scope's share of current Class 1 enrolment. All figures are synthetic demo data.
